leads.title: Senior Operations Manager (f/m/d)
leads.snippet: Your responsibilities ALEMI is looking for a Senior Operations Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our operational backbone — from forecasting and production orders to inbound logistics, stock, and cost control. You'll be the person who keeps product moving reliably from our production partners to our warehouse and stores, while building the processes and KPI discipline that let us scale.
